title: Dependency/CVE scanning
problem: Locked dependencies may contain known exploitable vulnerabilities.
rationale: New high/critical findings block product merge; expiry-bound legacy waivers possible with owner/removal condition. Network/database failure is Error; no result is not zero findings.
applicability: Resolved locked application, build, test and deployment dependencies.
baseline_policy: Owner/removal/expiry-bound vulnerability waivers only; no silent clean result.

target_check.deterministic: pip-audit, npm audit or OSV-Scanner against resolved locked dependency graph including build/test/deploy exposure; preserve advisory IDs, database/service time and graph hash.

expected_evidence: **D:** pip-audit, npm audit or OSV-Scanner against resolved locked dependency graph including build/test/deploy exposure; preserve advisory IDs, database/service time and graph hash. **R:** reachability/fix tradeoffs and unknown severity.
